name: shesha-developer
description: Skills for building applications on the latest Shesha framework (0.45). Scaffolds domain entities, database migrations, application services, DTOs, configuration items, fluent validators, domain events, notifications, SMS gateways, specifications, settings, forms, custom components, custom pages, and module projects following Shesha/.NET/ABP and NHibernate conventions. The designer pipeline is a compiler, not a prompt pipeline, with shesha-claude-designer as the single entry point: it routes by weight and orchestrates its execution layers — shesha-design-comprehension (measured layout blueprints + a schema-validated blueprint-json IR + placement verification), shesha-form-edit (compiles the blueprint into markup directly, typed against the measured capability matrix with theme tokens baked in, then gates → pushes → verifies), shesha-design-system (brand tokens → app theme + v7 style blocks). Ground truth is measured, not noted; the `/shesha-gym` command regenerates the 0.45 component KB, schema, and measured capability matrix (see shesha-form-edit/references/gym.md); mechanical facts live once in a rule registry (_rules.json) that validators and docs cite by id. Enforcement via plugin hooks: validate-on-write (schema → guardrails → styled-ness on any written markup) and a Stop-time persistence gate driven by a push ledger, plus a fail-closed render-instrument oracle. 0.45-only — 0.43 lives in the shesha-developer-0-43 plugin.
